==Description==
'''Refund Center''' was a location where players could get refunded for purchasing the [[Mercenary Base]] for {{Coins|10,000}}, when it was meant to be given for free. Upon entering, the game would check the player's save to determine eligibility; granting a refund if the player is qualified for it, or leaving the save unchanged if the player did not qualify.

Upon being refunded, the '''Refund Center''' could not be entered again.

==Appearance==
'''Refund Center''' was a waiting room. On the wall, there were two texts, one being ''REAL SWAG LLC'' and the other ''MISSING SOME COINS? WE'VE GOT YOU BACK!''. In the room, there were a few blue chairs and a table with three grey chairs next to it. In a corner, multiple boxes, papers and a single guitar case could be found. There was also a trash bin and a graph on the wall. On one side there was a glass door and on the other, there was an [[Elevators|elevator]]. Next to the [[Elevators|elevator]], there was a brown desk, with a humanoid next to it sitting on an office chair. On the desk, there was a laptop, phone and a coffee cup.

==Trivia==
*The '''Refund Center''' was located in a modified version of the fourth version of [[Cyber City]].
**The '''Refund Center''' itself did not appear in the actual map.
*The humanoid seen in the '''Refund Center''' is {{RLinkU|safazi}}, a developer for Tower Defense Simulator.
